ownership.legacy_cells: Segment.cells compatibility input excluded from canonical Design

physical_traces.source: Segment.physics density_kg_m3 or line_density_kg_m; Segment.sections, length_m
physical_traces.explicit_fact: material density or line density, section geometry and length
physical_traces.gvs: Gauss section quadrature along the continuous segment
physical_traces.backend: cell-midpoint section area times density and cell length

physical_traces.source: Section centroid and density; no single flexible COM field
physical_traces.explicit_fact: cross-section shape and its along-segment stations
physical_traces.gvs: quadrature material points placed by continuous strain kinematics
physical_traces.backend: body COM at cell half-length plus rotated section centroid, placed by hinges
physical_traces.independent_choice: continuous pose integration versus rigid-cell pose and lumping
physical_traces.observation: far COM gap 9.321 mm; payload world COM gap 16.673 mm at q0

physical_traces.source: Rigid.inertia_com_local_kg_m2 explicit; flexible inertia derived from density and section area moments
physical_traces.explicit_fact: rigid tensor, flexible density and section geometry
physical_traces.gvs: quadrature cross-section inertia plus distributed translation
physical_traces.backend: cell body inertia including m*ds^2/12, rotated into XML inertial frame
physical_traces.observation: rigid local tensors preserved; far deformed component inertia gap 13.34%

physical_traces.explicit_fact: world gravity and mount pose in the scene
physical_traces.gvs: sum m J_com.T g over continuous mass quadrature
physical_traces.backend: MuJoCo body COM Jacobians, equivalently -qfrc_bias at zero speed
physical_traces.independent_choice: COM pose and Jacobian from each representation
physical_traces.observation: generalized gravity gap 1.771e-3 N*m^2 at q0

physical_traces.source: PhysicalInput material E or equivalent EI; sections; natural_curvature_rad_m
physical_traces.gvs: integral of basis.T E I(s) (basis*q - natural curvature)
physical_traces.backend: cell-center principal E I / ds hinge stiffness and springref
physical_traces.observation: mapped stiffness matrix gap 18.3%; elastic force gap 0.442e-3 N*m^2

physical_traces.source: Tendon ordered attachment points and holes; straight_frictionless model; force limit and pretension
physical_traces.explicit_fact: route topology, anchor/guide locations, ideal frictionless span semantics
physical_traces.backend: compiler attachment sites, MuJoCo spatial tendon, negative gain direct tension
physical_traces.independent_choice: moment arms are derivatives of different deformed geometries
physical_traces.observation: route bindings and force sign match; Jacobian gap 2.33e-4 m^2/rad

physical_traces.source: Actuator command type, drum, transmission ratio, travel and speed limits; tendon servo gain
physical_traces.gvs: ideal tendon tension as model input; no motor state
physical_traces.backend: ideal_tension or actuator_realistic control mode from scene/control, XML actuator implementation
physical_traces.independent_choice: command-to-tension dynamics and execution mode belong to model/control
physical_traces.observation: Stage 3.7 direct-tension u0 matches exactly; motor dynamics omitted

physical_traces.source: section stations, connections and guide positions in design; cells in family.discretization; basis in GVS model parameters
physical_traces.explicit_fact: physical geometry and topology; numerical resolution is separate
physical_traces.gvs: structural_linear basis and 24 integration steps per segment
physical_traces.backend: three principal-hinge cells per segment in this case
physical_traces.independent_choice: deformation space, quadrature and cell placement
physical_traces.observation: q transfer exact; tip gap 16.743 mm at q0

physical_traces.source: Design.tip and RobotDescription.channels; mount, gravity, external forces and target in task environment
physical_traces.explicit_fact: named tip/channel interface and scene boundary conditions
physical_traces.gvs: requires assembly and rejects external applied forces in build_system
physical_traces.backend: scene mount, gravity, external forces and floor compiled into XML/execution
physical_traces.independent_choice: supported load/contact physics differ by model
physical_traces.observation: Stage 3.7 reference scene has no external forces

gaps.finding: No shared requirement says how a GVS state and cell state must agree in shape, COM, tendon Jacobian or force residual at a reference pose.
gaps.evidence: exact q transfer but 16.743 mm tip, 9.321 mm far COM and 1.771e-3 N*m^2 gravity gaps
gaps.scope: cross-model validation; not necessarily a new physical RobotIR field

gaps.finding: GVS basis/integration and serial cell count/sample rule are separate numerical policies. RobotIR physical geometry alone cannot force equal deformed states.
gaps.evidence: structural_linear versus three cells; 18.3% stiffness matrix gap
gaps.scope: backend-specific approximation that needs explicit provenance and convergence criteria

gaps.priority: HIGH for full Cosserat/FEM; outside current bending model
gaps.finding: PhysicalInput supplies E or bending EI and bending viscosity, not a full shear/torsion/axial or nonlinear 3D material law.
gaps.evidence: PhysicalInput schema; GVS and serial model capabilities explicitly omit shear, stretch and material torsion
gaps.scope: only needed if those richer physics are claimed

gaps.priority: MEDIUM for current comparison; HIGH for contact-rich models
gaps.finding: Ordered straight frictionless spans and guide points are explicit; guide contact/wrap, friction, cable elasticity and motor dynamics are not modeled.
gaps.evidence: Tendon.model literal and generator paths; route bindings agree but moment arms differ
gaps.scope: do not infer richer cable physics from current attachment data

gaps.finding: Flexible mass/COM/inertia are generated from section and density. Material-mode RobotIR defines a continuum distribution, but sampling/lumping is independent.
gaps.evidence: 0.0031% total mass gap but 9.321 mm far world COM gap
gaps.scope: preserve source density/sections; record generator sampling and reference-state COM

gaps.finding: Equivalent mode authorizes line density and principal bending EI without a volumetric Young modulus or density.
gaps.scope: sufficient for reduced bending; cannot uniquely determine a 3D material law

gaps.priority: HIGH for FEM; outside current rod scope
gaps.finding: Sections and envelopes describe rods and rigid bodies, not a material-labelled 3D solid with bonded/contact interfaces.
gaps.evidence: Section/Segment/Rigid contracts and compiler convex collision approximation
gaps.scope: required only when claiming volumetric fidelity

gaps.finding: Mount, gravity, external forces and target belong to task assembly, not RobotIR.
gaps.evidence: route.json task.environment and GVS build_system scene requirement
gaps.scope: keep boundary conditions explicit in a composed experiment; not missing robot facts

future_model_suitability.reason: The existing PCC provider reads family.design components/tip plus explicit curvature query; it does not claim loads or dynamics.

future_model_suitability.assessment: SUFFICIENT for declared restricted model; cross-model fidelity unverified
future_model_suitability.reason: Design supplies geometry/material/tendon inputs; basis and quadrature remain model parameters; no shear, stretch, torsion or contact.

future_model_suitability.assessment: SUFFICIENT for declared cell model; not continuum-equivalent by construction
future_model_suitability.reason: Design plus family.discretization and scene compile into cells, hinge springs, masses and spatial tendons.
Rod sections and connections exist, but full strain constitutive inputs, richer actuation and boundary semantics are absent; basis and strain modes must be chosen.
Cross sections could seed a simple rod mesh, but 3D material law, volumetric domains/interfaces and contact/boundary semantics are not specified.

conclusion.main_issue: model-dependent reconstruction and missing equivalence criteria, with conditional gaps for richer physics
conclusion.recommended_next_step: Define one frozen reference-state equivalence contract for shape, COM, gravity, stiffness and tendon Jacobian, including approximation provenance and tolerances, before proposing new RobotIR fields.
